summary: Tested admin sidebar visibility and menu cleanup on live Vercel URL. Authenticated login works. However, NEITHER of the two intended fixes are reflected on the deployed site: (1) /admin/images still renders WITHOUT the admin sidebar — it shows the public Header/Footer instead; (2) The /admin dashboard sidebar still contains all the old HBH menu items that were supposed to be removed.
passed: Admin login via /admin/login works (POST /api/admin/login -> 200, redirect to /admin)
/admin dashboard loads with sidebar visible (1 aside element)
All 5 expected sidebar labels are present on /admin (Dashboard, Analytics, Buchungen, Bildmanager, Zahlungen)
Image Manager page loads image data (8 images fetched) after auth

failed.issue: Old HBH menu items still present in sidebar on /admin dashboard. Visible items include: Hotels, Lagerhaltung, Inhalte, Email-Vorlagen, E-Mail-Protokoll, Airport Transfer, Erinnerungen. These were supposed to be removed per the review request.
failed.evidence: Screenshot of /admin shows left sidebar with these items under Admin/Travel Events heading. Body text contains all forbidden strings (Hotels, Lagerhaltung, Email, Airport, Erinnerungen, Automatisierung).

failed.issue: /admin/images does NOT render inside the admin layout. The admin sidebar is completely absent (0 aside elements); instead the page shows the public site Header (Reiseüberblick, Reiseroute, Hotels, Destillerien, Leistungen & Preise) and Footer around the Bilder-Manager content.
failed.evidence: After clicking 'Bildmanager' in sidebar from /admin, URL goes to /admin/images. Sidebar element count drops from 1 -> 0. Public nav labels appear in body text. Screenshot confirms public Header instead of admin sidebar.

action_items: Verify the Vercel deployment has actually been built with the latest changes to App.js (standalone /admin/images route removal), AdminDashboard.js (route cleanup), Sidebar.js (menuItems reduced to 5), and ImageManager.js (Header/Footer removed). Current live site clearly runs an older build.
If the code changes are merged locally but not deployed, trigger a Vercel redeploy and re-test.

If the changes are already deployed, re-check that: (a) /admin/images is routed INSIDE AdminDashboard (nested route under <AdminLayout> with Sidebar), not as a top-level route with its own Header/Footer; (b) ImageManager.js no longer imports/renders <Header /> and <Footer />; (c) Sidebar.js menuItems array only contains the 5 approved entries.
